description: Snapshot version generation. A versioning component assigns opaque version identifiers for the cluster set and the endpoint set of a group, so connected consumers can detect changes. The same group with unchanged clusters and endpoints keeps the same cluster and endpoint versions; changing only the endpoints generates a new endpoint version while the cluster version is unchanged; changing the clusters generates a new cluster version and also a new endpoint version. Versions are tracked per group identity. Because the raw identifiers are random, the output abstracts them into stable labels: each distinct cluster-version value seen (in order) is labelled c0, c1, ...; each distinct endpoint-version value e0, e1, .... Each version step prints 'step=<n> clusters=<label> endpoints=<label>', so equality and inequality across steps is observable without leaking the random values.

step=1 clusters=c0 endpoints=e1
